note: Family-owned RV park (since 2006) under live oaks on Charlie Smith Sr Hwy north of St Marys, across the road from Crooked River State Park; catch-and-release fishing pond. Weekly and monthly rates too; the owners say most guests stay about three days, snowbirds a month or two. No generators. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 35 sites (24 full-hookup 20x70-ft concrete pull-throughs + 11 others), 50/30/20 A, showers, laundry, wifi, dump at the pond sites; tax-included $50 (electric-only pond site) to $60 (full hookup / water-electric), weekly $385, monthly from $775; call to reserve, phone 912-576-5386 confirmed. Transient in character ('Most guests stay about three days with us'), so the long-stay tests pass. Price gate: the cheapest RV site is $50 tax included (under $50 before tax), so it passes on the electric-only pond sites; full hookups are $60 incl. tax (over). No gateway within 40 km (Jacksonville 57 km); no family stay. Note trimmed of the rate/booking/RV Life text.
flags: Price gate: passes only on the electric-only pond sites ($50 incl. tax, so under $50 before tax). The full-hookup and water/electric sites are $60 incl. tax, over the gate; no gateway within 40 km (Jacksonville 57 km, St. Augustine 107 km) and no family stay. The rates page prints no year (live page read 2026-10-29).

Waterfront lead (weak): the operator prices 'Daily Pond Rates' sites, and imagery shows a small pond south of the site rows with an RV row ~80-100 m away across open grass; stored 'not waterfront' looks right, but the pond-site naming is an operator water claim.
